Welcome to

PlanetForge

Planet Forge grows a whole world from nothing and lets you watch the entire story: molten rock cooling into oceans and continents, life taking hold, minds appearing, and nations reaching for the stars. Every world is different, and none of it is scripted.

🌋A living planetDrifting plates, volcanoes, impacts, weather, seasons and a climate that really moves heat around.
🌱LifeAppears only when conditions allow, branches into species, survives (or doesn't) mass extinctions.
🧠MindsRare. When they arise, nations grow, trade, fight, invent, and may leave the planet.
🎛YouWatch, speed time up, read the maps and graphs, or nudge the world: a comet, a volcano, a warmer sun.
Drag turnWheel zoomSpace pauseEsc menuE endless? all keys
♾ Endless mode is on: this world will never restart by itself. Press E or the Endless button to turn it off.
